# SH-287 / SH-290: the Flap rules pairs, the stake factory, Sweet Jar (BNB) and Pay Packet (test dollar).
# Generated by hackathon/flap-rules/make-commands.py. RPC=<the test network endpoint>; lines run from the repository
# root of the merged checkout; forge lines cd into bounties/flap in a subshell; addresses made by earlier steps are
# read from bounties/flap/deployments with jq when the line runs. Senders: hack-deployer 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576,
# hack-alice 0x2908E3351ec8F20a8a6746773e42EA1D2FFb3c7F, hack-bob 0xc979F6Cb8902f56f76b926358dC451cBF8f310F0. Gas price 0.1 gwei.
# Before step 8 and step 23 replace <META_SWEET> and <META_PACKET> with https://arweave.net/<id>#sha256=<hex>.
# A forge dry call simulates and writes the deployments file it would write; the send writes it again for real.

# 1 deploy the rules pair for BNB (4 tx) -> deployments/97-rules-native.json
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native forge script script/DeployRules.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native forge script script/DeployRules.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
cast call $(jq -r .rulesVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-native.json) 'quote()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000

# 2 deploy the rules pair for the test dollar (4 tx) -> deployments/97-rules-usdt.json
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=usdt forge script script/DeployRules.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=usdt forge script script/DeployRules.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
cast call $(jq -r .rulesVaultFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt.json) 'quote()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect 0x190C989D5665a0e404B444b53CAE9AbCfb600157

# 3 deploy the RailStakeFactory (1 tx) -> deployments/97-stake.json
( cd bounties/flap &&  forge script script/DeployStake.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap &&  forge script script/DeployStake.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
cast call $(jq -r .factory bounties/flap/deployments/97-stake.json) 'MIN_PERIOD()(uint256)' --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect 3600

# 4 Flap's helper: whitelist the rules BNB launcher factory at multiplier 0
cast call --from 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 0x77779969a11eff7582f3bCf48135A846A3457777 'whitelist(address,uint16)' $(jq -r .launcherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-native.json) 0 --rpc-url "$RPC"
cast send 0x77779969a11eff7582f3bCf48135A846A3457777 'whitelist(address,uint16)' $(jq -r .launcherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-native.json) 0 --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --rpc-url "$RPC" --chain 97 --legacy --gas-price 100000000
cast call 0x000042108465206185A077Edc3F3fd2b49060000 'launcherFactoryMultiplier(address)(bool,uint16)' $(jq -r .launcherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-native.json) --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect true 0

# 5 Flap's helper: whitelist the rules test-dollar launcher factory at multiplier 0
cast call --from 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 0x77779969a11eff7582f3bCf48135A846A3457777 'whitelist(address,uint16)' $(jq -r .launcherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt.json) 0 --rpc-url "$RPC"
cast send 0x77779969a11eff7582f3bCf48135A846A3457777 'whitelist(address,uint16)' $(jq -r .launcherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt.json) 0 --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --rpc-url "$RPC" --chain 97 --legacy --gas-price 100000000
cast call 0x000042108465206185A077Edc3F3fd2b49060000 'launcherFactoryMultiplier(address)(bool,uint16)' $(jq -r .launcherFactory bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt.json) --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect true 0

# 6 alice gets 0.06 tBNB from hack-deployer (curve buy, pool trade, gas)
cast call --from 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 0x2908E3351ec8F20a8a6746773e42EA1D2FFb3c7F --value 60000000000000000 --rpc-url "$RPC"
cast send 0x2908E3351ec8F20a8a6746773e42EA1D2FFb3c7F --value 60000000000000000 --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --rpc-url "$RPC" --chain 97 --legacy --gas-price 100000000
cast balance 0x2908E3351ec8F20a8a6746773e42EA1D2FFb3c7F --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=60000000000000000

# 7 bob gets 0.06 tBNB from hack-deployer (curve buy, pool trade, gas)
cast call --from 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 0xc979F6Cb8902f56f76b926358dC451cBF8f310F0 --value 60000000000000000 --rpc-url "$RPC"
cast send 0xc979F6Cb8902f56f76b926358dC451cBF8f310F0 --value 60000000000000000 --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --rpc-url "$RPC" --chain 97 --legacy --gas-price 100000000
cast balance 0xc979F6Cb8902f56f76b926358dC451cBF8f310F0 --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=60000000000000000

# 17 Sweet Jar: dispatch the tax processor's waiting vault share to the splitter (a measured zero is fine)
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=dispatch forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=dispatch forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )

# 18 Sweet Jar: the share-out among the rules (creator, pile, buy and burn)
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=distribute forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=distribute forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'delivered(uint256)(uint256)' 0 --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=1

# 19 Sweet Jar: the reads of each rule (no transaction): status, then the pile's and the burn's amounts
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=native SALE_FILE=deployments/97-rules-native-sale.json ACTION=status forge script script/RulesSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" )
cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'delivered(uint256)(uint256)' 1 --rpc-url "$RPC"
cast call $(cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-native-sale.json) 'pileVault()(address)' --rpc-url "$RPC") 'burned(uint256)(uint256)' 2 --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=1

( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=usdt SALE_FILE=deployments/97-rules-usdt-sale.json DEPLOYMENTS_FILE=deployments/97-rules-usdt.json ACTION=buy MAX_COST_WEI=300000000000000000000 forge script script/TokenSale.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2908E3351ec8F20a8a6746773e42EA1D2FFb3c7F --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-alice --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-alice.pass --broadcast )
cast call $(jq -r .launcher bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt-sale.json) 'tokensOf(address)(uint256)' 0x2908E3351ec8F20a8a6746773e42EA1D2FFb3c7F --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=1

# 36 Pay Packet: a sync counts the holders' part and streams it over a day
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=usdt SALE_FILE=deployments/97-rules-usdt-sale.json DEPLOYMENTS_FILE=deployments/97-rules-usdt.json ACTION=sync forge script script/Stake.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow )
( cd bounties/flap && VARIANT=usdt SALE_FILE=deployments/97-rules-usdt-sale.json DEPLOYMENTS_FILE=deployments/97-rules-usdt.json ACTION=sync forge script script/Stake.s.sol --rpc-url "$RPC" --sender 0x2EF9A78074bbf674bEA16f21154a30c821A3C576 --legacy --with-gas-price 100000000 --slow --account hack-deployer --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-deployer.pass --broadcast )
cast call $(jq -r .stake bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt-sale.json) 'arrived()(uint256)' --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=1

# 37 Pay Packet: alice claims what she earned so far (cast: gas estimated when it is sent)
cast call --from 0x2908E3351ec8F20a8a6746773e42EA1D2FFb3c7F $(jq -r .stake bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt-sale.json) 'claim()' --rpc-url "$RPC"
cast send $(jq -r .stake bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt-sale.json) 'claim()' --account hack-alice --password-file ~/.secrets/hack-alice.pass --rpc-url "$RPC" --chain 97 --legacy --gas-price 100000000
cast call $(jq -r .stake bounties/flap/deployments/97-rules-usdt-sale.json) 'claimed()(uint256)' --rpc-url "$RPC"   # expect >=1
